name: beacon_notfications
comment: Notifications stored as one row per user per notification. Should be registered as a virtual domain so any wiki can read it.

columns.name: notif_agent_id
columns.comment: User ID that triggered the notification; or NULL if system notification

columns.name: notif_page_id
columns.comment: Page ID on the originating wiki, or NULL.

columns.name: notif_page_title
columns.comment: Page DB key at send time

columns.name: notif_body
columns.comment: Rendered plain-text body or excerpt, in notif_language

columns.name: notif_language
columns.comment: Language code the header, body and link labels were rendered in

columns.name: notif_icon
columns.comment: Icon, either fully qualified URL or Codex icon name

columns.name: notif_links
columns.comment: JSON array of secondary links: [{label, url}] with rendered labels

columns.name: notif_group_key
columns.comment: Optional key for collapsing similar unread notifications

columns.name: notif_read
columns.comment: When the notification was read; NULL while unread

columns.name: notif_hidden
columns.comment: 1 if hidden because the page was deleted or suppressed

indexes.name: notif_user_id
indexes.comment: List all notifications for a user, newest first

indexes.name: notif_user_read
indexes.comment: List and count unread notifications for a user

indexes.name: notif_read_created
indexes.comment: Age-based purges of read and unread notifications

indexes.name: notif_wiki_page
indexes.comment: Hide on page deletion; purge when a wiki is removed

name: notification_user
comment: Per-user notification state, one row per user

columns.name: nu_seen
columns.comment: Last time the user opened the notifications panel

columns.name: nu_last_insert
columns.comment: Timestamp of the user's newest notification, for client cache validation
